graph.accessibleDescription: Interactive graph. Select a vertex by clicking it or using the vertex selector.
graph.interactionHelp: Drag to arrange · Scroll to zoom

matrix.complexEntries: Complex entries as [real part, imaginary part]
matrix.orderingHelp: Rows: outgoing neighbor z. Columns: incoming neighbor y. Display values are rounded; calculations use full precision.

errors.json: Enter valid JSON using [real part, imaginary part] pairs. Numeric entries use a decimal point in both languages.
errors.shape: Expected {{degree}} × {{degree}} entries, each a finite [real part, imaginary part] pair.
errors.apply: The matrix could not be applied. Check the entries and try again.
errors.complex: Enter finite numbers, a+bi, or [real, imaginary] pairs.
errors.unitary: The matrix is not unitary within tolerance 1e-10.

matrix.inputHelp: Enter real numbers, a+bi, or [real, imaginary] JSON pairs. Use decimal points.

plot.legendTip: Double-click on legend to isolate one trace

editor.draftHelp: Custom draft · Changes stay here while you try other presets. Export to keep them after closing this page.
editor.edgeStart: Connecting from {{vertex}}. Choose the second vertex.
editor.clearConfirm: Delete the entire custom draft, including all matrices and initial states?
editor.deleteVertexConfirm: Delete {{vertex}}, its incident edges and its scientific data? Data at surviving vertices is retained for review.
editor.structureReady: Graph and scattering matrices are ready.
editor.discardPresetDraft: Discard unapplied matrix edits on this preset?
editor.replaceDraft: Replace the existing custom draft? Export it first if you want to keep it.
editor.replaceMatrices: Replace every matrix with the selected preset in its current neighbor order?
editor.copyConfirm: Copy this matrix to {{count}} vertices in their displayed port order? Existing matrices will be replaced.
editor.matrixReview: Matrix needs attention. Current ports: [{{ports}}]. Apply a valid matrix or choose a preset explicitly.
editor.copyFrom: Copy from vertex of same degree
editor.applySameDegree: Copy to all other vertices of same degree
editor.seedHelp: Random and permutation presets use seed {{seed}}. Applying to all uses seed + vertex position in sorted ID order.
editor.initialReview: Choose or explicitly validate the initial state for the current basis. Existing entries are retained.
editor.stateHelp: Dimension {{dimension}}. JSON uses finite [real, imaginary] pairs and a decimal point. No automatic normalization.
editor.filesHelp: Export requires a valid custom experiment. JSON v1 includes positions, ports, complex matrices and the active initial state.
editor.endpoints: Undirected connection: {{a}} ↔ {{b}}. Both oriented arcs belong to the Edge Walk basis.
editor.undirected: Draw one undirected connection. The Edge Walk uses two oriented arcs per connection.

modes.selectHelp: Select a vertex or edge. Drag vertices to arrange them.
modes.addVertexHelp: Click empty canvas to place a vertex.
modes.addEdgeHelp: Click two distinct vertices to connect them.
modes.deleteHelp: Click an edge to delete it, or a vertex to review its deletion.

problems.minimum: Add at least two vertices and connect them.
problems.disconnected: The graph is disconnected. Connect all components before simulating.
problems.limit: The editor supports at most 32 vertices and 128 undirected edges.
problems.loop: Self-loops are not allowed. Choose a different second vertex.
problems.label: Use a nonempty label of at most 64 characters.
problems.unitary: Apply a unitary matrix of the current degree.

editor.pendingParameters: Unapplied boundary-vector / phase entries are retained. Validate and apply them before running the Vertex Walk or exporting.
editor.omegaPorts: Omega at {{vertex}} was entered for ports [{{old}}]; current ports are [{{current}}]. Review the entries before explicitly applying them in the new order.
